metas.name: CODA
metas.description: Ruby, the only hearing member of a deaf family, is torn between her family's fishing business and her dream of singing at Berklee. Winner of the Academy Award for Best Picture.

metas.name: Killers of the Flower Moon
metas.description: In 1920s Oklahoma, members of the oil-rich Osage Nation are murdered one by one, drawing the fledgling FBI into the case. Martin Scorsese's epic stars Leonardo DiCaprio, Robert De Niro and Lily Gladstone.

metas.name: Napoleon
metas.description: Ridley Scott's sweeping epic charts Napoleon Bonaparte's rise to power and his volatile, obsessive relationship with Josephine. Stars Joaquin Phoenix.

metas.name: Greyhound
metas.description: During WWII, a first-time Navy commander (Tom Hanks) leads an Allied convoy across the treacherous North Atlantic while hunted by U-boats.

metas.name: Emancipation
metas.description: Inspired by a true story: an enslaved man (Will Smith) flees a Louisiana plantation, braving the swamps to reach the Union Army and fight for freedom.

metas.name: Tetris
metas.description: The unbelievable true story of how Henk Rogers risked everything to secure the rights to Tetris from behind the Iron Curtain.

metas.name: The Banker
metas.description: Based on a true story: two Black entrepreneurs in the 1960s hire a working-class white man as the front for their real-estate and banking empire.

metas.name: Cherry
metas.description: An Army medic (Tom Holland) returns from Iraq with PTSD and spirals into addiction and bank robbery. Directed by the Russo brothers.

metas.name: Finch
metas.description: A dying inventor (Tom Hanks) builds a robot to care for his beloved dog after he's gone, and the trio sets out across a post-apocalyptic America.

metas.name: Swan Song
metas.description: A terminally ill man (Mahershala Ali) secretly clones himself so his family won't have to grieve - then wrestles with whether to go through with it.

metas.name: The Tragedy of Macbeth
metas.description: Joel Coen's stark black-and-white take on Shakespeare's tale of ambition and murder, starring Denzel Washington and Frances McDormand.

metas.name: Spirited
metas.description: A modern musical spin on A Christmas Carol: Ryan Reynolds plays the miser visited by the Ghost of Christmas Present (Will Ferrell).

metas.name: Causeway
metas.description: A soldier (Jennifer Lawrence) returns home with a traumatic brain injury and forms an unlikely bond with a mechanic as she rebuilds her life.

metas.name: Sharper
metas.description: A family of con artists runs an elaborate long con on a Manhattan billionaire in this twisty neo-noir starring Julianne Moore.

metas.name: Argylle
metas.description: A reclusive spy novelist (Bryce Dallas Howard) learns her fictional plots are mirroring real espionage, pulling her into a globe-trotting adventure.

metas.name: The Family Plan
metas.description: A former elite assassin (Mark Wahlberg) has built a quiet suburban life - until his past catches up and puts the whole family on the run.

metas.name: Wolfs
metas.description: Two rival professional fixers (George Clooney and Brad Pitt) are hired for the same job and forced to clean up a high-profile crime together.

metas.name: The Gorge
metas.description: Two elite snipers posted on opposite sides of a mysterious gorge must join forces when an unspeakable evil rises from below.

metas.name: F1
metas.description: A washed-out Formula 1 driver (Brad Pitt) returns to the grid to mentor a rookie teammate and chase one last shot at glory.

metas.name: Ghosted
metas.description: A lovesick everyman (Chris Evans) follows his dream girl (Ana de Armas) to London, only to learn she's a CIA operative - and now he's a target too.

metas.name: Flora and Son
metas.description: A struggling Dublin single mother reconnects with her rebellious teenage son through songwriting, guided by a Los Angeles guitar teacher.

metas.name: The Beanie Bubble
metas.description: The outrageous true story of Ty Warner and the Beanie Babies craze that turned plush toys into a 1990s investment mania.

metas.name: On the Rocks
metas.description: A young mother (Rashida Jones) teams up with her charming, roguish father (Bill Murray) to spy on her possibly unfaithful husband.

metas.name: Palmer
metas.description: An ex-convict (Justin Timberlake) returns to his Louisiana hometown and becomes the reluctant guardian of a gender-nonconforming boy.

metas.name: Cha Cha Real Smooth
metas.description: A directionless college graduate becomes a party starter on the New Jersey bar mitzvah circuit and falls for an older mother.

metas.name: The Boy, the Mole, the Fox and the Horse
metas.description: Oscar-winning animated short about four unlikely friends wandering the winter wilderness in search of home, kindness and wisdom.

metas.name: Still: A Michael J. Fox Movie
metas.description: An intimate documentary on Michael J. Fox's life and career, and his public and private journey living with Parkinson's disease.

metas.name: Fly Me to the Moon
metas.description: A 1960s NASA PR specialist (Scarlett Johansson) clashes with a by-the-book launch director (Channing Tatum) - while secretly staging a backup fake moon landing.
